storyPara1: Y7 Consulting Inc, operating as Y7 Logistics, is a US-based auto transport brokerage. Our team brings 10+ years of combined auto transport experience, with Y7 operating as an FMCSA-licensed broker since 2025. We connect shippers with verified carriers through Central Dispatch — the industry's leading load board.
storyPara2: From auction pickups to cross-country relocations, we handle every detail so our customers don't have to. Our dispatch team coordinates carriers, manages documentation, and keeps you informed at every step.

steps.title: Receive Order
steps.desc: Customer submits vehicle details, pickup and delivery locations.

steps.title: Vet & Assign Carrier
steps.desc: We match your load with a verified, insured carrier through Central Dispatch.

steps.title: Monitor Transit
steps.desc: Status updates and notifications from pickup to delivery.

steps.title: Deliver & Document
steps.desc: Signed BOL, condition reports, and delivery confirmation on file.

commitments: Response to new inquiries under 1 hour during business hours
Only verified, insured carriers assigned to your load
Documentation at every step — BOL, gate passes, condition reports
Transparent pricing with no hidden fees or surprise charges
Customer portal and Telegram bot for status updates
fmcsaText: Y7 Consulting Inc is registered with the Federal Motor Carrier Safety Administration (FMCSA) as an auto transport broker.

comms.title: How Y7 Communicates
comms.lead: Y7 operates on a two-channel model: digital-first customer support, and phone-enabled last-mile delivery coordination. Here is why.

support.title: Customer Support: Digital-First
support.desc: All interactions with Y7 staff happen through written channels with a full audit trail.
items: Client Portal — orders, documents, status, messages
Telegram Bot — instant status, quick quotes
Email — info@y7agency.com for inquiries and non-order questions (contracts and invoices are delivered via portal)
All orders, modifications, and document access happen through the Client Portal

delivery.title: Delivery Coordination: Driver Contact
delivery.desc: When your carrier is assigned, you receive the driver's direct phone number for delivery logistics.
items: Physical delivery needs real-time voice coordination (ETA, directions, unload point)
Industry standard for all FMCSA-licensed brokers

benefits.title: Why this model works better
items: Written audit trail for every decision
Faster response — no phone tag, no waiting on hold
